note: make gate-commit crashed on lefford (any host over the canonical box) with Argument list too long, unconditionally, before a single test ran -- unrelated to whatever .rs change was staged. Root cause: Linux execve rejects a single argv or envp string over MAX_ARG_STRLEN, 32 times PAGE_SIZE = 131072 bytes, a compile-time kernel constant, not a ulimit. The committed docs/timings/subfloor-roster.tsv renders to a 186387-byte flat OR filterset, over that limit, identical on origin main -- so this bites every dot-rs commit made from a Linux canonical-box worktree, not just this campaigns. Fixed in campaign the-sluice: scripts/subfloor-run-chunked.sh runs the same single filterset invocation when it fits, and splits into argv-safe chunks above the threshold, stopping at the first failing chunk. Verified end to end via a real gate-commit run, 2 chunks, 1480 plus 1281 tests, all green. See commit 41bafadf.
